g.title: MlQube: Enterprise ML Platform on AWS
g.text: MlQube: Enterprise ML Platform on AWS
1 · High-level architecture · internal developer platform for ML/AI on Amazon EKS

g.title: legend
g.text: Identity: single sign-on through IAM Identity Center
Code: ML engineers push Python (Hera) pipelines to GitHub
Delivery: the management cluster deploys and provisions everything through GitOps
Models: promotion from non-prod to prod, then serving to applications
Data: clusters use shared S3, ECR, RDS and Secrets Manager
Control: policies, audit and cost per business unit
